dialogs.evidence_quote: `CODES` opens `SEARCH CODE` (category radios, sort, search, transfer list)
dialogs.notes: Read from vendor dialog screenshots (article on finding patients with a specific code in the treatment plan). Opened by the SELECT button of the CODES picker on Treatment Plan Detail and Treatment Plan Status. The category values, the sort options, the search box and the transfer list are quoted in the Treatment Plan Detail section of the research document. On Treatment Plan Detail the CODES box is empty by default, on Treatment Plan Status it shows ALL (our capture); whether this dialog has an Include All tick or APPLY / CANCEL buttons is not described in this document.

The picked statuses are removed from the report and echoed by code in the report footer (`Exclude Tx Plan : S,C`). The status values are quoted in the Treatment Plan Status criteria table of the research document; only the visible part of the list is known, and no APPLY / CANCEL buttons are described.

dialogs.evidence_quote: Pickers open on `Include All`; a narrower selection needs `Include All` unticked
dialogs.notes: General rule, stated from the vendor's article on the new reports menu and applied by the research document to all reports. It is named explicitly only for the PROVIDER and CARRIER pickers (own entries above) and is not shown individually for the other pickers whose box shows ALL: TX COUNSELOR, CODES on Treatment Plan Status, ORTHO STATUS, APPOINTMENT PROVIDER, VISIT DOCTOR. It does not hold literally for every picker: the exclusion pickers show None by default - the one documented exclusion dialog, SELECT TREATMEN PLAN, carries a NONE tick instead - the office box opens on the logged-in office (ALL only on 835 Denial Report), and the CODES box of Treatment Plan Detail opens empty.
